settings.access.full.label: Full access
settings.access.full.body: Full access turns every pause below off at once: the agent runs with no permission prompt, an ask goes where its intake routed it, finished work lands by the landing rule with no Accept…, and no go-ahead is asked for. An agent that cannot run that way refuses to start, saying so. Your own deny rules hold in every setup, and a go-ahead the ask itself demands is asked whatever this says. It applies to sessions that start from now on.
settings.access.full.on: On: sessions start with every pause below off.
settings.access.full.off: Off: sessions stop at each pause as it stands below.
settings.access.full.offs: Full access turns off permission prompts, an ask waiting for you to accept its route, Accept… before landing, and go-aheads.
settings.access.full.stays: It never turns off your own deny rules, nor a go-ahead the ask itself demands.
settings.access.confirm.label: Turn on full access for {{name}}
settings.access.confirm.named: Let sessions in {{name}} run with no permission prompt, take an ask where its intake routed it, land finished work by the landing rule with no Accept…, and act without go-aheads? Your own deny rules still hold, and a go-ahead the ask itself demands is still asked. It applies to sessions that start from now on.
settings.access.confirm.machine: Let sessions on this machine run with no permission prompt, take an ask where its intake routed it, land finished work by the landing rule with no Accept…, and act without go-aheads, wherever a workspace or a repository sets none of its own? Your own deny rules still hold, and a go-ahead the ask itself demands is still asked. It applies to sessions that start from now on.
settings.access.why.permissions: Whether a session's agent stops to ask you before a tool call its rules do not settle. Your own deny rules hold whatever this says.
settings.access.why.routing: Whether an ask waits for you to accept the repositories its intake chose before their sessions start.
settings.access.why.landing: Whether a quest's finished work waits for your Accept… or lands by the repository's landing rule, pushed as the rule says.
settings.access.why.goAheads: Whether a session asks for your go-ahead before the acts the repository's own documents name, such as a production system. A go-ahead the ask itself demands is asked either way.
settings.access.says.permissions.asking: The agent asks you before each tool call its rules do not allow.
settings.access.says.permissions.auto: The agent's auto mode decides each tool call its rules do not settle, as today.
settings.access.says.permissions.unrestr: No permission prompt: the agent runs in its harness's mode that asks nothing.
settings.access.says.routing.person: An ask waits for you to accept the route its intake chose, as today.
settings.access.says.routing.intake: An ask goes where its intake routed it; you may route it again.
settings.access.says.landing.person: Finished work waits for your Accept… before it lands, as today.
settings.access.says.landing.rule: Finished work lands by the landing rule, with no press.
settings.access.says.goAheads.named: A go-ahead is asked before the acts the repository's documents name, as today.
settings.access.says.goAheads.never: No go-ahead is asked, save one the ask itself demands.
settings.access.says.questions: As in Claude Code: a session asks only what it cannot decide, at its turn's end, in its own conversation, and goes on when you answer there. Every setup works this way.
settings.access.from.mixed: Each pause below says where it was set.
settings.access.savedFull.named: Sessions in {{name}} now start with full access.
settings.access.savedFull.machine: Sessions on this machine now start with full access.
settings.access.savedToday.named: Sessions in {{name}} now stop at each pause as today.
settings.access.savedToday.machine: Sessions on this machine now stop at each pause as today.
settings.access.cleared.named: {{name}} takes its sessions' access from what stands above it again.
settings.access.cleared.machine: Sessions on this machine stop at each pause as Daoris's default again.
settings.access.pauseCleared: {{pause}} for {{name}} comes from what stands above it again.
